question: Through whose grace has the determination of the Kaula teaching become known?
premises: The speaker claims knowledge has arisen
The knowledge concerns the determination of Kaula
The cause is the grace of the lord of Kaulas
inference: By the grace of the lord of Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
